typography.scale: 1.25 modular ratio with clamp() display sizing

color.palette_strategy: 60% warm white, 30% navy, 10% aqua; warm gold appears only in the original award badge

spacing: 8pt grid: xs 8, s 16, m 24, l 32, xl 48, 2xl 64, 3xl 96, 4xl 128
radius: soft: 4px on controls; square editorial image edges
motion: 180ms controls, 600ms reveals, ease cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); a single 4.8s water shimmer; reduced-motion disables all movement
texture: none; real water photography provides the surface detail
